summary: Iter40 end-to-end tested Admin Team Live Chat document & voice attachments (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 9/9 passed in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_live_chat_attachment.py: (a) POST /api/admin/live-chat/messages/attachment RBAC — unauth 401/403, student 403; (b) validation — .exe unsupported ext rejected 400, empty file rejected 400; (c) happy path uploads for all three management roles (admin, super_admin, admin_wilayah) — response never leaks attachment.storage_path, includes id/original_filename/content_type/size; (d) GET /api/admin/live-chat/attachments/{id} authenticated via Bearer AND via ?auth=<token> returns 200 with correct Content-Type; (e) student token and unauthenticated denied on download endpoint (401/403); (f) audio/webm upload accepted, super_admin GET list shows the message with attachment metadata (no storage_path), admin_wilayah can also download; (g) 404 on unknown attachment id. A temporary admin_wilayah user (Jakarta Pusat) was provisioned via POST /api/admin/users by super_admin and cleaned in teardown. Regression: existing /app/backend/tests/test_student_live_chat.py still 20/20 passed (student attachments PNG/PDF, magic-byte enforcement, oversize, cross-student RBAC unaffected). Frontend Playwright on preview URL logged in as Admin Provinsi (admin.mdj@baznasbazisdki.id), opened menu-live-chat, verified live-chat-attachment-input + live-chat-attachment-label + live-chat-record-button + live-chat-selected-file testids render on the Tim Admin channel. Uploaded a PDF: rendered as anchor a[data-testid=live-chat-attachment-<uuid>] with FileText icon and href containing ?auth=<token>; performed authenticated fetch of that href from the browser context — HTTP 200 with content-type application/pdf. Uploaded a webm audio fixture through the same file input path (bypassing MediaRecorder mic permission): rendered as <audio controls data-testid=live-chat-audio-<uuid>>. Clicking live-chat-record-button toggled its label from 'Rekam suara' to 'Selesai rekam' confirming MediaRecorder start works in the headless Chromium (fake audio input is present). Cleanup verified via mongosh: 3 TEST_iter40 admin_live_chat_messages deleted; 0 orphan test_iter40_wilayah users remaining; 0 TEST_iter40 messages remain in DB. Object-storage blobs for the three test uploads are unreachable per spec (no delete API) — matches Emergent Object Storage constraint noted in the review request.

issues: Existing Tim Admin session already contained two seeded messages ('Mas Suya ada keluhan...' / 'Oh iyah kak JB silahkan apa keluhannya?') from prior iterations/dev usage. They are not test data (no TEST_ prefix) so were NOT deleted, but main agent should verify whether they were intentionally seeded or leftover dev-time chatter — if unintentional, remove during production readiness.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In LiveChat.jsx line 210 the anchor uses target='_blank' and puts the bearer token in the URL query string (?auth=<token>). Any external referrer / browser history / server access log will now capture a valid JWT. Recommend switching to axios blob download via `api.get(..., { responseType: 'blob' })` + object URL, or a short-lived signed URL server-side.

OPTIONAL: POST /api/admin/live-chat/messages/attachment stores the object BEFORE inserting the DB record. If the DB insert fails, the object storage blob is orphaned (Emergent Object Storage has no delete API). Consider validating and building the record first, then storing only after DB write succeeds — same carry-over pattern noted in iter39.

OPTIONAL: Unlike the Student Live Chat attachment endpoint (which enforces magic-byte checks + 5MB cap in test_student_live_chat.py), the admin attachment endpoint only checks extension whitelist and 15MB cap. A malicious admin could rename an executable to .pdf and upload — recipients would then download data mismatched to the declared content_type. Consider adding python-magic based sniffing consistent with the student endpoint.
OPTIONAL: Server returns 200 (not 201) on successful attachment creation; consider 201 Created for REST correctness.
OPTIONAL: Consider persisting sender_role='admin_wilayah' -> UI label mapping so the message header shows 'Admin Wilayah <region>' rather than default sender_name.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /admin/live-chat/messages/attachment: validates extension whitelist and size (1..15MB) but no magic-byte check. Student attachment endpoint DOES check magic bytes (see test_student_live_chat.test_attachment_magic_byte_mismatch) — inconsistency in trust model between roles.

server.py GET /admin/live-chat/attachments/{id}: accepts token via cookie, Authorization header, OR ?auth= query param. Token-in-URL is convenient for <a href> download but is logged by proxies and browsers; consider signed short-lived URLs instead.

LiveChat.jsx keeps the mic MediaStream open until user clicks 'Selesai rekam'. If the user navigates away mid-recording the getUserMedia stream is never explicitly stopped — browser tab-mic indicator will linger. Add cleanup on component unmount / on error branches.

LiveChat.jsx submits FormData but still passes 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' header manually — this strips the auto-generated boundary and breaks axios in some setups. The current axios build appears to still work but best practice is to omit that header and let axios set it.
serialize_admin_chat_message() correctly strips storage_path from responses (verified in list + POST + audio-in-list flows). Good.

Attachment records are stored inside the admin_live_chat_messages collection under a nested 'attachment' object — this makes cleanup easy but means the collection now holds heterogeneous shapes. Consider a discriminator field ('kind': 'text'|'attachment') for future indexing.
Preview URL currently retains two non-TEST admin chat messages from prior sessions; if this is a shared preview, main agent may want a seed reset script.

If retesting the UI, note that the login page inputs have no name/id — use placeholder-based selectors (input[placeholder*='email' i] and input[type=password]) and then click button[type=submit]. Preview Chromium seems to have a fake-audio device: MediaRecorder starts without prompting, so click of live-chat-record-button toggles Rekam suara -> Selesai rekam without user gesture; MediaStream cleanup on unmount is currently missing (see review comments).
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Optional hardening: (1) Bearer token in <a href=?auth=> is leaked to any target that receives the URL (browser history, proxy logs). Repro: open Live Chat as Admin Provinsi, upload PDF, right-click the rendered TEST_*.pdf link → 'Copy link' → the JWT is in the URL. Mitigation: change LiveChat.jsx to trigger download via authenticated axios blob request rather than <a href>. (2) Admin attachment endpoint has no magic-byte check unlike the student endpoint. Repro: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -F 'attachment=@evil.exe;filename=notes.pdf' /api/admin/live-chat/messages/attachment` → 200. Mitigation: mirror the python-magic sniffing already used in the student attachment path.
